# Upstream-only paths that this fork intentionally does not carry.
# One path per line; blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored.
#
# After `git merge --no-commit <upstream ref>` run
#   bash .github/scripts/upstream_excluded_paths.sh prune
# to resolve every listed path as deleted. CI runs the `check` mode and fails
# when any of them reappears. See docs/operations/upstream-release-integration.md.
#
# Nightly Release only runs from refs/heads/main and fails every night on the
# fork/dev default branch; the other workflows drive upstream's own release,
# tunnel and pages deployments.
.github/workflows/nightly.yml
.github/workflows/release.yml
.github/workflows/rust-ci.yml
.github/workflows/build-tunnel.yml
.github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml
